headline: Drone Attacks Strike Shendi Power Substation in Sudan
summary: Drones knocked out the main electricity substation in Shendi, River Nile State, marking the eleventh power or fuel facility targeted within two weeks.
why: Attacks on critical energy infrastructure severely impair supply chains, regional stability, and economic output.

impacts.name: Sudan
impacts.why: Destruction of a key power substation disrupts regional energy supply.
